name: Moonray: Battle Lands
detailed_description:
Enter the surreal battlegrounds of Moonray, a free-to-play third-person PvP battle arena set in a breathtaking science fantasy world. In this skill-based combat experience, you'll fight to win the favor of the gods across floating islands and impossible architecture, where only the most skilled warriors will claim victory.

MASTER THE ART OF COMBAT

Moonray's combat system rewards skill, strategy, and quick reflexes. Choose your fighting style from an arsenal of unique weapons, each with distinct advantages and combo potential:

  • Agile Sabre: Strike with lightning speed, chaining fluid combos that leave opponents struggling to counter

  • Powerful Cleaver: Deliver devastating blows that can turn the tide of battle in a single, well-timed strike

  • Precision Blaster: Pick off enemies from a distance with accurate shots that disrupt their strategies

  • Explosive Cannon: Control the battlefield with area-of-effect damage that can catch multiple opponents in its blast

Master the timing-based combo system that rewards practice and precision. Learn to balance offensive aggression with defensive counters, creating a combat dance where every move matters and split-second decisions determine victory or defeat.

DOMINATE THE VERTICAL BATTLEFIELD

The grappling hook is your key to battlefield dominance in Moonray. This versatile tool transforms how you approach combat:

  • Quickly escape dangerous situations when outnumbered

  • Close the distance on ranged opponents for devastating melee attacks

  • Access strategic vantage points for battlefield control

  • Surprise enemies with unexpected angles of attack

  • Create your own combat style by mastering vertical movement

The most feared warriors in Moonray aren't just skilled with their weapons—they're masters of movement, using the grappling hook to outmaneuver and outthink their opponents.

COMPETE ACROSS MULTIPLE GAME MODES

Test your skills in a variety of challenging game modes designed to showcase different aspects of combat mastery:

  • Deathmatch (8-Player): Every warrior for themselves in a chaotic free-for-all where only the strongest survive

  • Team Deathmatch (4v4): Join forces with allies to outfight and outwit the opposing team

  • Objective-Based Modes: Capture strategic points and complete tactical goals while fending off enemy attacks

  • Duel Mode (1v1): The purest test of skill—face a single opponent with nowhere to hide and no one to rely on but yourself

Each mode offers a unique challenge, requiring you to adapt your strategies and master different aspects of Moonray's combat system.

BATTLE IN SURREAL, DYNAMIC ARENAS

The environment itself can be your greatest ally or deadliest enemy. Use explosive barrels to create chaos, navigate collapsing bridges that change the battlefield mid-fight, and adapt to dynamic obstacles that force constant tactical reassessment.

PROGRESS AND CUSTOMIZE

Your journey in Moonray is one of constant growth and personalization:

  • Advance through a rewarding level-based progression system

  • Unlock powerful new weapons with unique combat characteristics

  • Customize your warrior with distinctive character skins

  • Express your personal style with a variety of cosmetic items

  • Climb the competitive leaderboards to prove your mastery

Every match brings you closer to new options for customization and combat, ensuring that your experience in Moonray continues to evolve as you play.

IMMERSE YOURSELF IN A STUNNING WORLD

Moonray's visual and audio design creates an unforgettable sensory experience:

  • Explore otherworldly landscapes with impossible architecture and surreal beauty

  • Witness breathtaking lighting effects that enhance the dreamlike atmosphere

  • Experience the impact of combat through responsive visual feedback and particle effects

  • Lose yourself in the electronic-orchestral hybrid soundtrack that dynamically responds to the action

  • Feel every blow through impactful sound design that gives weight to each combat encounter

The post-human world of Moonray is unlike anything you've experienced before—a vibrant, surreal battleground where the ruins of a once-thriving civilization provide the stage for your combat prowess.

JOIN THE FIGHT

Moonray is constantly evolving, with regular updates bringing new content and refinements to the experience. Currently in alpha stage, the game is expanding to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and Mobile, with cross-platform play planned to unite warriors across all systems.

Will you rise to the challenge? The gods are watching, and only the most skilled combatants will earn their favor. Enter the arena, master your weapons, and claim your place among the legends of Moonray.

SKILL-BASED COMBAT SYSTEM

Master Moonray's deep combat mechanics that reward practice and precision. Chain devastating combos, time your defensive counters perfectly, and develop your own fighting style with a variety of weapons that offer distinct advantages and playstyles.

REVOLUTIONARY GRAPPLING HOOK MOVEMENT

Dominate the vertical battlefield with the grappling hook, a game-changing tool that lets you quickly escape danger, close distance on enemies, access strategic vantage points, and create unexpected angles of attack that will keep your opponents guessing.

DIVERSE GAME MODES

Test your skills across multiple challenging formats including chaotic 8-player Deathmatches, strategic 4v4 Team battles, objective-based competitions, and intense 1v1 Duels that showcase pure combat mastery.

SURREAL, DYNAMIC ARENAS

Fight across meticulously designed maps featuring floating islands, impossible architecture, and interactive elements that change mid-battle. Use the environment to your advantage with explosive hazards, collapsing bridges, and strategic choke points.

PROGRESSION AND CUSTOMIZATION

Advance through a rewarding level-based system that unlocks powerful new weapons, distinctive character skins, and various cosmetic items. Express your personal style while expanding your combat options with each match you play.

BREATHTAKING AUDIOVISUAL EXPERIENCE

Immerse yourself in Moonray's stunning post-apocalyptic world featuring vibrant colors, dramatic lighting, and otherworldly landscapes. Experience the impact of combat through responsive visual feedback and a dynamic electronic-orchestral soundtrack.

EXPANDING UNIVERSE

Currently in alpha stage with regular updates bringing new content and refinements. Expanding to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and Mobile with cross-platform play planned to unite warriors across all systems.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 7700k / AMD Ryzen 5600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / GeForce RTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 12500k / AMD Ryzen 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
